question: Which active implementation should define the official Linux companion architecture and permanent ownership boundary?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested Linux app, while the C/GTK, Rust/GTK, and Tauri candidates make incompatible platform and supply-chain choices that cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Choose native GTK path
options.body: Select the strongest Linux-native candidate after security, packaging, and real-behavior review, then close or redirect the overlapping alternatives.

options.title: Choose Tauri desktop
options.body: Adopt the shared cross-platform shell and explicitly approve its broader runtime, dependency, and packaging footprint.

options.title: Pause official implementation
options.body: Retain this roadmap issue but pause the current candidates until an official platform owner and staged specification are named.

recommendation.title: Choose native GTK path
recommendation.body: Select the strongest Linux-native candidate after security, packaging, and real-behavior review, then close or redirect the overlapping alternatives.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue contains the clearest product-direction signal for a GTK-native Linux app and the priority tradeoff with security work.
